summary.lv: Starlab SIA — Fintech uzņēmums — meklē Operational Support Specialist, kurš/-a apstrādās maksājumu darījumus, risinās strīdus ar partneriem un uzraudzīs maksājumu kanālu darbību.
summary.en: Starlab SIA, a Fintech company, seeks an Operational Support Specialist to handle daily transaction processes, address payment-related issues, ensure compliance with payment policies, and monitor payment channel performance.
